entries.description: Offline studio for authoring SillyTavern lorebooks (World Info) with Git-like versioning. A single-page application that runs entirely in the browser: projects stay in local IndexedDB and no user data ever leaves the device. Imports and exports SillyTavern World Info JSON (plus V2-spec character books, PNG or JSON character cards, and .stproj archives), preserving unknown fields so files round-trip untouched. Requires a browser with JavaScript enabled; there is no server API to call.
representativeQueries: edit a SillyTavern World Info lorebook in the browser
lint lorebook entries for recursion and key problems
keep git-like version history of a character book
export a lorebook without losing unknown fields
